title: Module sheafification over a presheaf of rings on a site
statement: Let $(\mathcal C,J)$ be a site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], let $\mathcal O$ be a presheaf of commutative rings on $\mathcal C$ with sheafification $\mathcal O\to\mathcal O^\#$ as a presheaf of rings, and let $\mathcal P$ be a presheaf of $\mathcal O$-modules [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification], with $\mathcal P\to\mathcal P^\#$ its sheafification as a presheaf of abelian groups [def-weil-pbc-sheafification]. There is a unique map of sheaves of sets $\mathcal O^\#\times\mathcal P^\#\to\mathcal P^\#$ compatible with $\mathcal O\times\mathcal P\to\mathcal P$, and it makes $\mathcal P^\#$ a sheaf of $\mathcal O^\#$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Moreover, for every sheaf $\mathcal G$ of $\mathcal O^\#$-modules, every morphism of presheaves of $\mathcal O$-modules $\mathcal P\to\mathcal G$ (with $\mathcal G$ regarded as a presheaf of $\mathcal O$-modules by restriction of scalars along $\mathcal O\to\mathcal O^\#$) factors uniquely as $\mathcal P\to\mathcal P^\#\to\mathcal G$ with $\mathcal P^\#\to\mathcal G$ a morphism of $\mathcal O^\#$-modules. Hence $\mathcal P\mapsto\mathcal P^\#$ is a functor from presheaves of $\mathcal O$-modules to sheaves of $\mathcal O^\#$-modules, left adjoint to restriction of scalars, whose underlying abelian sheaf is the abelian sheafification.
